_comment: Identifies the corpus that golden_data_template_detection_v3.csv was labelled against. The corpus itself is third-party publication XML and is deliberately not tracked in git (.gitignore excludes *.xml); this manifest lets anyone holding a copy prove it is the same one, instead of silently scoring against a different corpus. Verify with: python scripts/evaluate_template_detection.py --corpus-dir phase0_asco_xml_output_v3 ...
checksum_algorithm: content_integrity.pipeline._input_manifest_checksum (sha256 over each file's root-relative path then bytes, in sorted path order)
